answer: Trust should flow outward from a few known-honest seeds along real interaction edges, as in random-walk scoring on the social graph. Honest agents who trade with many different partners around the wharf keep the walks circulating among them. A fake cluster can link its own accounts endlessly, but only a few edges reach the honest side, so almost no trust leaks in. Each clone ends with a faint umber smudge of score, a comet tail that fades below the payout line.
